core: Core circadian clock transcriptional feedback loop
name: Core clock BMAL1:CLOCK activation and CRY:PER repression
rationale: All members concern circadian control of gene expression through the BMAL1:CLOCK transactivation/CRY:PER repression loop itself, whereas confusables add NPAS2/NPAS4, ROR/REV-ERB, PGC-1alpha and metabolic or glucocorticoid outputs of the clock.

name: Somite segmentation and rostrocaudal compartment specification
rationale: Members share somitogenesis and specification of somite rostral/caudal compartments (including LFNG-linked spondylocostal dysostosis), distinct from axis elongation/tail, Notch O-glycosylation and hindbrain/neural plate patterning confusables.

qualifier: broad signature with CCL2 production restraint
name: Broad inflammatory cytokine and chemokine response
rationale: All three members describe a general inflammatory cytokine/chemokine output (including negative control of MCP-1), rather than the chemokine-receptor binding, monocyte chemotaxis or myeloid NF-kB activation of the confusables.

name: Deoxynucleotide and pyrimidine nucleotide catabolism
rationale: Members are dominated by breakdown of deoxyribonucleotides/deoxynucleosides and pyrimidine nucleotides (including ADA and PNP defects), whereas confusables centre on de novo synthesis, salvage and interconversion.

core: Sex determination and reproductive organ development
name: Sex determination, gonad and reproductive tract morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover male sex determination, testis/Leydig differentiation, AMH signaling and uterus, oviduct, vagina and genitalia development, unlike confusables focused on prostate, mammary gland or germ cells and seminiferous tubules.

name: Apoptotic nuclear dismantling and PAK-2p34 signaling
rationale: Members share apoptotic execution events (DNA fragmentation, chromatin condensation, lamina breakdown) and, uniquely versus the confusables, regulation of the caspase-generated PAK-2p34 fragment.

name: Immunological synapse formation and proximal TCR signaling
rationale: Members share T cell polarity, raft localization, lymphocyte aggregation and synapse assembly (CORO1A-DEF6), plus second-messenger generation and Nef signaling that the Rho-GTPase and surface-signature confusables lack.

qualifier: nucleotide-sugar supply and Golgi terminal elongation
name: Nucleotide-sugar supply and Golgi protein glycan elongation
rationale: Members span UDP-GlcNAc/GDP-fucose/CMP-sialic acid synthesis and transport, N- and O-glycan elongation, sialylation, fucosylation and blood-group antigens with their CDG defects, distinct from glycosphingolipid, ER N-glycan processing and lysosomal catabolism confusables.

core: Oncogenic and hematopoietic tyrosine kinase signaling
qualifier: ALK, FGFR, PDGFR and EPO/TPO STAT5
name: Oncogenic ALK/FGFR/PDGFR kinases and EPO/TPO STAT5 signaling
rationale: Members combine ALK TKI-resistance, FGFR/PDGFR/FLT3 fusion signaling and erythropoietin/thrombopoietin/IL-3 STAT5 cytokine signaling, while confusables add KIT, ERBB2 and FLT3 TKI-resistance sets absent here.

name: PPARG-driven white adipocyte differentiation and fat expansion
rationale: Members share white adipogenesis, its PPARG/MLL3-4 transcriptional control and positive regulation of adipose growth, unlike confusables centred on negative regulation, LXR/PPARA lipid metabolism or clock regulators.

qualifier: fork stress, cross-link repair and recombination resolution
name: Replication fork stress, cross-link repair and recombination resolution
rationale: Members share repair at stalled replication forks (Fanconi/ICL repair, fork reversal, BIR, SDSA, intermediate resolution, genotoxic drug responses), whereas confusables centre on DSB sensing, NHEJ, BRCA defects or ADP-ribosylation.

name: Coagulation cascade initiation and amplification
rationale: All members describe the normal coagulation cascade, distinct from confusables defined by factor VIII/IX defects or fibrinolysis and platelet degranulation.

name: Chorionic trophoblast and placental labyrinth development
rationale: Members share chorionic trophoblast proliferation, differentiation and migration with chorio-allantoic fusion and labyrinth vascular branching, unlike confusables on giant cells, decidualization or trophectoderm/ICM.

name: B cell and plasma cell immunoglobulin signatures
rationale: Members are B cell and plasma cell/immunoglobulin expression modules plus plasma cell differentiation, lacking the germinal centre, Tfh, memory and surface-signature members of the confusables.

qualifier: HSF1 heat shock and p53/anoikis apoptosis control
name: HSF1 heat shock response and stress-induced apoptosis regulation
rationale: Members combine HSF1 activation/attenuation and heat acclimation with regulation of p53-mediated DNA-damage apoptosis and anoikis; confusables carry only one of these halves plus UPRmt, stress granules or acetylation.

name: Hindbrain and spinal cord neuron specification and patterning
rationale: Members span both spinal cord dorsoventral patterning and motor/interneuron fate and hindbrain/brainstem development, whereas each confusable holds only one region plus floor plate, midbrain or cranial nerve terms.

name: TCA cycle intermediates and glutamate-glutamine anaplerosis
rationale: Members link the TCA cycle and its intermediates (malate, oxaloacetate, 2-oxoglutarate, pyruvate) to glutamate, glutamine and alanine metabolism, while confusables add aspartate, the malate-aspartate shuttle, respiration or gluconeogenesis.

name: M-CSF and IL-6 signaling via ERK1/2 and STAT3
rationale: Members share CSF1-driven macrophage signaling and interleukin SHC signaling, and uniquely versus confusables include IL-6/JAK-STAT3 and ERK1/2 activation.

name: Cardiac outflow tract, great artery and semilunar valve morphogenesis
rationale: Members share neural crest-dependent outflow tract septation, pharyngeal/pulmonary/coronary artery and aortic/pulmonary valve morphogenesis, unlike confusables on BMP/lung vasculature, second heart field or atrioventricular cushions.

name: Integrin-fibronectin adhesion and spreading with MET-FAK signaling
rationale: Members share integrin/syndecan-fibronectin adhesion, stress fibres, spreading and migration, and only this theme includes MET coupling to PTK2 and tensins.

name: SUMO conjugation cycle and substrate sumoylation
rationale: Members cover SUMO processing, E1/E2 transfer, desumoylation and sumoylation of substrate classes, while confusables hold substrate sets without the enzymatic cycle or PML-body/nuclear transport terms.

qualifier: CRH and corticosterone driven fear behaviour
name: Fear and stress response to CRH and corticosterone
rationale: All members concern the organismal stress response (CRH, corticosterone, fear, general adaptation syndrome), unlike confusables on reward/social behaviour, neuropeptide sleep regulation or glucocorticoid secretion.

name: Gastrulation, mesendoderm and definitive endoderm-gut tube formation
rationale: Members share gastrulation, primitive streak EMT, mesendoderm and lateral mesoderm formation with pluripotency control, and add endoderm specification and foregut/hindgut morphogenesis lacking from the cardiac and left-right confusables.

name: Metallothionein-MTF1 metal response and ROS detoxification
rationale: Members join MTF1/metallothionein responses to copper, zinc, manganese and iron with ROS detoxification and redox homeostasis, whereas confusables cover only nitrosative stress or toxic heavy metals and copper transport.

name: Lipid droplet triglyceride mobilization and fatty acid oxidation
rationale: Members share lipid droplet dynamics, lipolysis, lipophagy and regulation of fatty acid uptake and beta-oxidation (carnitine shuttle, adiponectin), whereas confusables emphasise triglyceride and phospholipid synthesis.
